academic_translation:
In order to take hold of that precious mind,
To the Tathāgatas and the sublime Dharma,
The stainless Jewel, and the children of the Buddhas,
Who are oceans of good qualities, I make excellent offerings.
translation: I want to take hold of that precious mind. So I make wonderful offerings to the Thus-Gone Ones and the holy teachings. I make offerings to the spotless Jewel and to the children of the Buddhas. They are oceans of good qualities.

academic_translation:
Whatever flowers and fruits there are,
And whatever kinds of medicine there are,
Whatever jewels there are in the world,
And whatever pure and pleasing waters there are,
translation: I offer all the flowers and fruits there are. I offer every kind of medicine. I offer all the jewels in the world and all the pure, pleasing water.

academic_translation:
Jewel mountains, and likewise
Forest regions, secluded and delightful,
Trees adorned and embellished with flowers,
And trees whose branches bow with excellent fruit,
translation: I offer mountains made of jewels. I offer quiet and delightful forests. I offer trees decorated with beautiful flowers. I offer trees with branches bending down from excellent fruit.

academic_translation:
Even in the worlds of gods and others, fragrances,
Incense, wish-fulfilling trees, and jewel trees,
Various crops that grow without being ploughed,
And other ornaments worthy of being offered,
translation: I offer sweet smells and incense from the worlds of gods and others. I offer wish-granting trees and jewel trees. I offer crops that grow without being planted. I offer every other beautiful thing that is worthy of being offered.

academic_translation:
Lakes and ponds adorned with lotuses,
Possessing swans with highly sweet and pleasing voices,
Reaching the limits of the infinite realm of space,
All those things that are unpossessed,
translation: I imagine lakes and ponds filled with lotuses. Beautiful swans sing sweetly there. I picture everything out to the edge of endless space that belongs to no one.

academic_translation:
Taking them up with my mind, to the Sages, the supreme among persons,
Together with their children, I excellently offer them;
May those supreme worthy recipients of offerings, those of great compassion,
Think of me with love and accept these things of mine.
translation: In my mind, I gather all these things. I offer them to the Sages and their children. They are the ones worthy of gifts. May those of great compassion think of me with love and accept my offerings.

academic_translation:
I am without merit and extremely destitute,
And I have no other wealth at all for making offerings.
Therefore, may the Protectors who consider the welfare of others
Accept this for my sake by their own power.
translation: I have no store of goodness, and I am very poor. I have no other wealth to offer. Therefore, may the Protectors who care about the good of others accept this for my sake.

academic_translation:
To the Victors and their children,
I shall offer my entire body forever.
O supreme beings, please completely accept me;
With devotion I will become your subject.
translation: I offer my whole body forever to the Victorious Ones and their children. O greatest heroes, please accept me completely. With deep respect, I will serve you.

academic_translation:
Because I am completely accepted by you,
I will be fearless in existence and act for the benefit of sentient beings.
I will perfectly transcend my previous misdeeds,
And will commit no other misdeeds henceforth.
translation: Because you have accepted me, I will be brave in this life. I will help all living beings. I will leave behind my past harmful deeds. From now on, I will not do any more harmful deeds.

academic_translation:
In exceedingly fragrant bathhouses,
Arranged with clear and shining crystal floors,
Endowed with pleasing pillars of blazing jewels,
And with canopies of radiant pearls spread above,
translation: I picture wonderful, sweet-smelling bathhouses. They have clear and shining crystal floors. Beautiful pillars made of bright jewels hold them up. Sparkling covers made of pearls are spread above.

academic_translation:
To the Tathāgatas and their children,
With many precious vases of scented water,
Well filled with what is pleasing,
Accompanied by manifold songs and music, I offer a bath.
translation: I offer a bath to the Thus-Gone Ones and their children. I use many beautiful vases full of sweet, scented water. I give this bath with lots of songs and music.

academic_translation:
Their bodies, with matchless garments,
Clean and thoroughly perfumed, I dry.
Then, to them, I offer excellently dyed,
Exceedingly fragrant, supreme robes.
translation: I dry their bodies with clean, beautiful cloths that smell like perfume. Then I offer them the very best robes. These robes are perfectly colored and smell wonderful.

academic_translation:
With various fine garments, thin and soft,
And hundreds of those supreme ornaments,
The noble Samantabhadra and Mañjuśrī,
Avalokiteśvara and others, I shall also adorn.
translation: I will also decorate the noble Samantabhadra, Manjushri, Avalokiteshvara, and others. I will use many fine clothes that are thin and soft. I will give them hundreds of the very best ornaments.

academic_translation:
With supreme perfumes, whose fragrance wafts
Throughout the three-thousandfold world system,
I shall anoint the bodies of all the Lords of Sages,
Radiant and blazing like polished, refined gold.
translation: I will rub the best perfumes on the bodies of all the Lords of Sages. The sweet smell spreads through the whole world of three thousand worlds. Their bodies shine and glow like polished gold.

academic_translation:
To the Lords of Sages, the supreme objects of offering,
With pleasing mandāra flowers and lotuses,
Blue lotuses, and all other fragrant flowers,
And beautifully strung, pleasing garlands, I make offerings.
translation: I make offerings to the Lords of Sages, the best ones worthy of offerings. I offer beautiful heavenly flowers, lotuses, blue lotuses, and all other sweet-smelling flowers. I also offer them beautiful flower garlands that are strung together perfectly.

academic_translation:
From supreme incense, captivating and pervasive in fragrance,
Cloud-masses of smoke I also offer to them.
With meals comprising various foods and drinks,
Divine feasts I shall also offer to them.
translation: I offer them thick clouds of smoke from the very best incense. The wonderful smell fills the air. I will also give them a feast of the gods, made of many different foods and drinks.

academic_translation:
Within golden lotuses arranged in rows,
I shall also offer precious lamps.
Upon the smoothed ground anointed with perfume,
I shall scatter pleasing loose flowers.
translation: I will offer precious lamps inside rows of golden lotuses. I will scatter lovely flowers on the smooth, sweet-smelling ground.

academic_translation:
Immeasurable palaces endowed with pleasing songs of praise,
Beautifully blazing with hanging ornaments of pearls and jewels,
Which have become ornaments of boundless space:
These too I shall offer to those whose nature is compassion.
translation: I also offer palaces beyond measure that echo with beautiful songs of praise. They shine brightly with hanging pearls and jewels, decorating the endless sky. I offer these to those whose nature is compassion.

academic_translation:
Beautiful jeweled parasols with golden handles,
Endowed with pleasing forms of ornaments all around,
Well-shaped, lovely to behold, and raised aloft:
These too I shall always offer to the Lords of Sages.
translation: I offer beautiful jeweled umbrellas with golden handles. They have lovely decorations all around. They are perfectly shaped, wonderful to look at, and held high. I will always offer these to the Lords of Sages.

academic_translation:
Besides these, multitudes of offerings,
Endowed with music and pleasing, sweet melodies:
May clouds that soothe the suffering of sentient beings
Remain in their respective places.
translation: I also give many other offerings along with beautiful, sweet music. May clouds that soothe the suffering of living beings stay in all these places.

academic_translation:
Upon all the jewels of the sublime Dharma,
Upon the stūpas and the images,
May a rain of jewels, flowers, and the like
Fall without interruption.
translation: May a rain of jewels, flowers, and other gifts fall without stopping upon all the jewels of the holy teachings. May it also fall upon the shrines and statues.

academic_translation:
Just as Mañjuśrī and the others
Make offerings to the Victors,
Likewise, I make offerings to the Tathāgatas,
The Protectors, along with their children.
translation: Just as Manjushri and others make offerings to the Victorious Ones, I do the same. I make offerings to the Thus-Gone Ones, the Protectors, and their children.

academic_translation:
I praise those who are oceans of good qualities
With oceans of branches of melodious praise.
May those sweet clouds of melodious praise
Certainly arise everywhere for them.
translation: I praise those who are an ocean of good qualities. I praise them with oceans of beautiful songs. May clouds of this sweet music rise up everywhere for them.

academic_translation:
To all the Buddhas who have gone in the three times,
Along with the Dharma and the Supreme Assembly,
With bodies as numerous as all the atoms in the fields,
Bowing down, I pay homage.
translation: I bow down to every Buddha of the past, present and future. I bow down to the teachings and the Supreme Assembly. I imagine having as many bodies as all the atoms in the land. All of my bodies bow down.

academic_translation:
To the bases of bodhicitta
And to the stūpas, I pay homage.
To the preceptors and likewise the masters,
And to the supreme ascetics, I pay homage.
translation: I bow down to every basis of the awakening mind and to the shrines. I bow down to the teacher who ordained me and to my other teachers. I also bow down to every person of strict practice.

academic_translation:
Until I reach the essence of awakening,
I take refuge in the Buddhas.
In the Dharma and the bodhisattvas'
Assembly, likewise, I take refuge.
translation: Until I reach the heart of awakening, the Buddhas are who I go to for shelter. I also look to the teachings and the assembly of awakening heroes for shelter.

academic_translation:
To those who reside in all directions,
The fully awakened Buddhas and those with bodhicitta,
Who possess great compassion,
Joining my palms, I pray:
translation: I put my hands together and pray. I pray to the fully awakened Buddhas who live in all directions. I pray to those with the awakening mind. They all have great compassion.

academic_translation:
From beginningless saṃsāra,
In this life or in others,
Whatever misdeeds I have unwittingly committed
Or caused to be committed,
translation: I have lived in this cycle of rebirth with no beginning. In this life and in past lives, I have done harmful deeds without knowing it. I have also made others do harmful deeds.

academic_translation:
Overwhelmed by the confusion of ignorance,
Whatever I have rejoiced in,
Having seen those mistakes,
I confess them to the Protectors from the depths of my heart.
translation: Sometimes ignorance confused me. I used to feel joy in my mistakes. Now I see how wrong they were. I own up to them to the Protectors from the bottom of my heart.

academic_translation:
To the Three Jewels,
To parents, or to other teachers,
Through the gateway of the afflictions, with body, speech,
And mind, whatever harm I have done,
translation: I have done harm to the Three Jewels, my parents, and my teachers. Driven by a troubling emotion, I harmed them with my body, my speech, and my mind.

academic_translation:
Stained by many faults,
Whatever misdeeds I, one burdened with misdeeds,
Have committed that are extremely unbearable,
I confess them all to the Guides.

locked_terms.use: one who has done harmful deeds

translation: I am stained by many faults. As one who has done harmful deeds, I have done terrible things. I own up to every harmful deed to the Guides.

academic_translation:
Without the purification of my misdeeds,
I will die before that happens.
So that there is definite liberation from these misdeeds,
Please protect me swiftly.
translation: I might die before the cleansing of my harmful deeds. Please protect me quickly so I can have sure freedom from them.

academic_translation:
This Lord of Death cannot be trusted;
He does not wait for what is done or not done.
Whether sick or healthy,
No one can trust this life, which can end suddenly.
translation: The Lord of Death cannot be trusted. He does not wait to see if our work is done or not. Whether we are sick or healthy, no one can trust this life. It can end suddenly.

academic_translation:
That I must depart, leaving everything behind,
Not having understood this,
For the sake of friends and enemies,
I have committed various kinds of misdeeds.
translation: I did not understand that I must go and leave everything behind. For the sake of friends and enemies, I have done many kinds of harmful deeds.

academic_translation:
Enemies will cease to be,
And friends will cease to be;
I too will cease to be,
And likewise everything will cease to be.
translation: Enemies will disappear. Friends will disappear. I will disappear too. Everything will fade away.

academic_translation:
Just like the experiences of a dream,
Whatever things I have enjoyed
Will become objects of memory;
All that has passed will not be seen.
translation: Just like a dream, everything I have enjoyed will become only a memory. Nothing from the past will be seen again.

academic_translation:
Even during this very life,
Many friends and enemies have passed away;
The unbearable misdeeds committed for their sake
Are what remain before me.
translation: Even in this life, many friends and enemies have passed away. The terrible harmful deeds I did for them are what stay with me.

academic_translation:
Because I did not realize
That I am transient in this way,
Through ignorance, attachment, and hatred,
I have committed many kinds of misdeeds.
translation: I did not understand that I will not last forever. Because of ignorance, clinging, and hatred, I have done many kinds of harmful deeds.

academic_translation:
Without pausing by day or night,
This life is constantly diminishing;
Since no addition comes from elsewhere,
Why would someone like me not die?
translation: Day and night, my time alive is always running out. Since no more time is ever added, why would someone like me not die?

academic_translation:
While I lie upon my bed,
Even though surrounded by all my relatives and friends,
The sensations of my life being severed
Will be experienced by me alone.
translation: When I lie on my bed, my family and friends might surround me. But I alone will feel my life ending.
